title: Don Quixote
author: Miguel de Cervantes
summary: A retired gentleman reads so many chivalry romances that he decides to become a knight, and sets out with his neighbour Sancho Panza as squire. Windmills, inns and travellers all become battlegrounds in his mind.
readIf: you want a funny, humane classic that invented a lot of what novels do today.
skipIf: you want a tight plot, because it is long and episodic.

pairings.reason: Another satire in which one stubborn mind refuses to accept the world as others see it.
A far lighter, shorter comic classic with a similar love of absurd adventure.
Another satirical classic of travel and absurdity, with a sharper edge.
